import re
NODE = re.compile(r'^(?P<ind> *)(?P<node>[A-Z][A-Z_]*)(?: (?P<name>(?!compact\s*$)\S+))?(?: (?P<compact>compact))?\s*$')
CONTENT = re.compile(r'^ +content=(?P<content>.*)$')
NS = re.compile(r'^ +namespace (?P<prefix>\S+) href=(?P<href>.*?)\s*$')
PROP = re.compile(r'^(?P<key>\w+)=(?P<value>.*?)\s*$')

def parse(lines):
    nodes, props, nss = [], {}, []
    nl, pl, sl = [], [], []
    stack = []
    for i, ln in enumerate(lines):
        if not ln.strip():
            continue
        m = NODE.match(ln)
        if m:
            ind = len(m.group('ind'))
            while stack and stack[-1][0] >= ind:
                stack.pop()
            parent = stack[-1][1] if stack else None
            rec = {'id': len(nodes) + 1, 'parent': parent['id'] if parent else '',
                   'parent name': (parent['name'] or parent['node']) if parent else '',
                   'depth': len(stack), 'node': m.group('node'), 'name': m.group('name') or '',
                   'compact': 'compact' if m.group('compact') else '', 'content': ''}
            nodes.append(rec)
            stack.append((ind, rec))
            nl.append(i)
            continue
        m = CONTENT.match(ln)
        if m and nodes:
            nodes[-1]['content'] = m.group('content')
            nl.append(i)
            continue
        m = NS.match(ln)
        if m and nodes:
            nss.append({'node': nodes[-1]['id'], 'element': nodes[-1]['name'],
                        'prefix': m.group('prefix'), 'href': m.group('href')})
            sl.append(i)
            continue
        m = PROP.match(ln)
        if m:
            props[m.group('key')] = m.group('value')
            pl.append(i)
    return [{'name': 'document', 'kind': 'kv', 'lines': pl, 'records': [props]},
            {'name': 'nodes', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': nl, 'records': nodes},
            {'name': 'namespaces', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': sl, 'records': nss}]
